race.comment: ANOTHER CASHIE (3) is a progressive gelding and finds a nice race to land a winning blow. Caught the eye fresh when rattling home here, and was good last time without winning, again doing his best work late. Was slow to recover last time too, so that adds more merit to the run. If Mallyon can settle closer from the low draw he will prove extremely tough to hold out. CLIMB THE LADDER (1) returns and makes his stable debut for the Gollan camp. Has always shown ability and has been fitted with a trial win here in readiness. Can make a bright start in the new colours. BUCKEYE (8) disappointed punters in his first three runs for the stable but was better last time when closing off strongly into second at the Sunny Coast. The stable look to have a better hold on him now. PODIUM STAR (7) is yet to strike this campaign but knocking on the door and should be hitting his straps fourth-up. Is a lightly raced 5YO that holds genuine appeal from a good draw.
